title: Single hieratic sign, Paris, Musée du Louvre, E 25279 (AKU HT 61112)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 61112

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 61112; AKU grapheme S0710 (AKU GR 597). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: S42 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 416, 449, 450, 451. Source publication of this facsimile: Posener-Kriéger und Cenival 1968, pl. 5 A. Occurrence: line 4; find place Pyramidenkomplex des Neferirkare Kakai; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 4 x 1.9 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 5. Dynastie, Djedkare". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
